title: spt01_provisioning_test.zig TC-SPT-01-07 expects empty tenant context to resolve search_path to tenant_default, but src/db/pool.zig intentionally implements empty-context-means-public
summary: Discovered while implementing and verifying the ISS-0095 fix (GitHub #349). tests/integration/spt01_provisioning_test.zig's TC-SPT-01-07 explicitly clears tenant context to an empty string after makePool() has already run, then asserts that pool.acquire() resolves search_path to 'tenant_default'. src/db/pool.zig's connection-acquire routing logic (around lines 155-176, applyRequestStorageRouting-equivalent) documents and implements the opposite behavior on purpose: an empty/absent tenant id is treated as the 'no resolved tenant' branch, which sets search_path TO public, not to any tenant schema (including tenant_default). This is a pre-existing test/implementation contract mismatch, unrelated to the ISS-0095 fix (the test explicitly overrides tenant context back to empty after makePool()'s own correct .set() call runs, so ISS-0095's fix has no bearing on this test case either way).

root_cause.details: Either TC-SPT-01-07's expected behavior is wrong (empty context should indeed map to public, and the test needs updating), or src/db/pool.zig's public-fallback-on-empty-context behavior is wrong for this specific caller pattern (and should default to tenant_default instead of public when no tenant is set) -- this needs a product/design decision, not a unilateral code change by whichever agent picks it up next. The two are currently in direct contradiction and only one can be correct.

files_to_change: Needs upstream design decision first: either tests/integration/spt01_provisioning_test.zig's TC-SPT-01-07 assertion (if the intended behavior is empty-context-means-public, matching pool.zig's current documented implementation), or src/db/pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting()-equivalent logic around lines 155-176 (if the intended behavior is empty-context-means-tenant_default, matching the test's expectation). Do not change both independently without confirming which one is the actual product requirement -- that would just make the two agree without knowing if the agreed-upon behavior is correct.

occurrences.context: Found by BACKEND-DEV while implementing the ISS-0095 fix, confirmed unrelated since the test explicitly re-clears tenant context after makePool()'s own (now-correct) .set() call, specifically to exercise the empty-context code path as its own test subject.

prevention: When a test explicitly asserts behavior for an edge case (like empty/absent tenant context), cross-check the assertion against the implementation's own doc comments before merging the test, not after it starts failing in an unrelated fix's full-suite run.
